text: tried out omakub. some tinkering involved to make things work but not bad at all.
title: Omakub — An Omakase Developer Setup for Ubuntu 24.04+ by DHH

claude.summary: Omakub is DHH's one-command developer setup for Ubuntu 24.04: it installs a curated set of apps, themes, fonts and dev tooling on top of a fresh install. It is the Ubuntu predecessor of Omarchy.
